verdict: Coherent's revenue jumped 50% to $2.37B as AI datacenters switch from copper to optical links, and net income rose to $382M — with the company expecting pro forma revenue growth above 60% this fiscal year.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: $2.37B in revenue, vs $1.58B a year ago (+56% pro forma)

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $1.19 a year ago; non-GAAP EPS was $2.09

kpis.label: Gross margin (GAAP)
kpis.note: Up from 36.6% a year ago on pricing and cost improvements

segments.name: Datacenter & Communications
segments.note: Lasers, transceivers and optical switches that move data inside and between AI datacenters — the growth engine, driven by AI demand and data-center interconnect.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.note: Photonics for factories, medical and other industrial uses — down mainly because Coherent sold its aerospace and defense business in September 2025 and its Munich business in January 2026.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building new photonics products — transceivers, optical circuit switches and multi-rail systems for AI datacenters. 10% of revenue.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling and running the company — 13% of revenue, down from 16% a year ago as revenue outgrew costs; it includes higher stock-based pay. (Shown as $304M so the rounded lines balance; $305M before rounding.)

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: Costs of consolidating and closing manufacturing sites, mainly employee termination and move costs (shown rounded; see note below).

takeaways.title: AI datacenters are the story
takeaways.text: Datacenter & Communications revenue rose 79% to about $2.0B as AI datacenters transition from copper to optical connectivity. Industrial revenue fell 15% to $419M, mostly because of businesses Coherent sold. Management expects a first $3B revenue quarter by the end of fiscal 2027.

takeaways.title: Margins are climbing
takeaways.text: GAAP gross margin rose to 39.1% from 36.6% a year ago on pricing, lower input costs and manufacturing yield gains. Coherent now targets its first quarter of non-GAAP gross margin above 45% before the end of calendar 2028.

takeaways.title: Spending hard to keep up
takeaways.text: Coherent spent $776M on property and equipment in the quarter and built up $737M of inventory, so operating cash flow was negative $93M despite the profit — it is investing ahead of expected demand. Second-quarter revenue is guided to $2.55B–$2.75B.

oneTimers: The tax line was a $23M benefit rather than a cost, helped by deferred-tax effects — one reason net income grew faster than pre-tax income. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.09 excludes $74M of stock-based compensation, acquired-intangible amortization, restructuring and similar items that GAAP counts.
otherDetail: Other expense of $19M, net: $46M of interest expense, partly offset by $27M of other income.
footerNote: Coherent reports in thousands; figures here are rounded to $M so the lines balance (gross profit $928M and operating income $378M as reported; segment amounts are $1,952M and $419M before this rounding). Net earnings of $382M include a $3M loss attributable to noncontrolling interests, so $385M was attributable to Coherent shareholders.
